Thanks for reaching out. Our team is aware of some of our players are encountering  the following message “Listing certain items for sale is restricted due to insufficient gameplay record."

To help prevent bots, fraudulent purchases, scams, and other forms of abuse, the trust system may apply temporary restrictions to certain account features based on an account’s Trust Status. The AION 2 Trust Status System is part of our Operational Policy to support a fair gameplay environment and improve service security. Depending on an account’s trust status, access to features like the Market/Exchange may be limited.

Important note about Trust Status

Even after an account becomes trusted, its trust status can be changed due to factors including (but not limited to):

    Suspicious account activity
    Use of suspicious software
    Engaging in RMT (real-money trading)
    Botting behavior
    Playing from an unsupported region
    Use of a VPN

Trust status is reviewed regularly. If an account appears to have lost trusted status despite none of the above applying, it may be flagged for re-evaluation. 

What you can do

    Please avoid using a VPN and confirm you’re playing from a supported region.
    Ensure no third-party tools/software are running alongside the game.
    Continue normal gameplay and check the Market/Exchange again later, as reviews occur periodically.

We’ll continue keep an eye on this and ensure the system is working as intended. If the restriction continues, reply with your character name, server, and the exact error message (screenshot if possible) so we can look into this further.

Thank you for contacting AION 2 Support.
We understand your concerns regarding your account's trust status and the restrictions you may be experiencing when attempting to access certain in-game features, such as the Market or Exchange.

To help maintain a fair and secure gameplay environment, AION 2 utilizes a Trust Status System designed to protect players against fraudulent activity, botting, real-money trading (RMT), and other forms of abuse.

Under this system, certain account features may be restricted depending on an account's current trust status. Please be aware that trust status is not permanent and may change based on various account security and activity factors.

Some factors that may affect an account's trust status include:

Suspicious account activity or unusual account behavior
Detection of suspicious or unauthorized software
Activities associated with real-money trading (RMT) or botting
Accessing the game from unsupported regions
Use of VPN services


Please understand that a restriction to your account's trust status does not necessarily indicate that you have violated the game's policies or received a disciplinary sanction. These restrictions may also be applied as a preventive security measure.

Trust Status Review
Account trust status is currently being reviewed. If your account has lost trusted status and is determined to be in good standing following a subsequent review, its trusted status may be reinstated.

For security reasons, we are unable to disclose the specific criteria, detection methods, or internal processes used to determine an account's trust status.

We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to maintain a safe and fair gaming experience for all Daevas.
For additional information, please refer to our official announcement: AION 2 Trust Status System Notice

Thank you for your continued support of AION 2
m:
Issue: User reported restrictions on Market or Exchange access due to their account's trust status.
Resolution: Explained the Trust Status System, potential factors affecting trust status, and that accounts may be reviewed for reinstatement.

If the server transfer option appears in red, it may be due to one of the following reasons:

Server type restrictions: Transfers between Early Access and Launch servers are not available during the current transfer period. Transfers between Launch servers are scheduled to become available on October 21.

Transfer capacity: The destination server may have reached its transfer limit. New slots open hourly during the designated transfer windows.

Character requirements: Your character may not meet the transfer requirements. Please make sure your character is in a village, is not part of a Legion, and has no pending items or currency to claim.

Please check these conditions and try again. If the issue persists, let us know so we can look into it further.
